title: Combined interactions and ecotoxicological effects of micro/nanoplastics and organic pollutants in soil–plant systems: a critical overview
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00072F, Critical Review
Open Access

Yu Xie, Yaping Lyu, Samina Irshad, Xingxin Liu, Yaqi Jiang, Yi Sun, Ziqi Zhang, Haojie Wei, Huiyi He, Changcheng An, Peng Zhang
Micro/nanoplastics (MNPs) are widespread and developing environmental pollutants that can interact synergistically with organic pollutants (OPs) in terrestrial ecosystems, posing potential threats to the soil–plant ecosystem.
